title: Etler Hub Auto Trait Farm Auto Farm Boundless Tower
features:
Etler Hub is an automation hub for A Universal Time. Set a config once and it runs the grind without you, swapping stands and farming your exact target traits while you're away.

FREE 24 HOUR TRIAL
Test the complete hub, nothing locked. Open a ticket in the Discord and you get a trial key: the full premium build, not a stripped demo.

WHAT IT DOES

Hands-Free Trait Farming (Kaitun)
Drop in a config and walk away. Auto-swaps your stands and specs, farms your exact target traits, and a Discord webhook alerts you the moment a Godly or Hexed trait lands.

Aerial & Ground Auto-Farm
Mobs and bosses on autopilot with built-in combat assists, including a live parry engine for the Camellite Golem.

Full Economy Automation
Khronos Lab reputation, rank rewards, skin recycling and forging, Camellite mining, and auto-sell.

Everything Else
Auto-Stats, Auto-Traits, Quests, Area Teleports, Combat Helpers, Physics Overrides, FPS and performance tuning, Save/Load configs, quick menus.

Built to run AFK overnight. Regular updates, active support.

SUPPORTED EXECUTORS
Confirmed working: Potassium and Volt (paid), Madium, Delta and Project Real (free). Any executor with solid sUNC that runs Luarmor scripts will work.
